verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the BILL v3 API platform explicitly covers Spend & Expense (S&E) including 'card & expense management services' and 'virtual cards' setup, and other object types (vendors) show concrete POST/PATCH endpoint patterns, suggesting similar CRUD exists for cards — but no endpoint, payload, or example specifically for creating a card with a limit, locking a card, or updating card controls is shown. Missing for 10: explicit card creation/lock/control-update endpoint documentation, example requests/responses, and independent confirmation of programmatic card lifecycle management.
